product.name: Quantix Objective Lens Adapter
product.description: The Quantix Objective Lens Adapter provides a versatile solution for upgrading microscope objective lenses across multiple brands. Designed with precision‑machined aluminum and high‑grade polymer housing, the adapter fits standard 1.25‑inch threads and supports 0.75× to 5× objective lenses. Its compact 12‑cm length and 0.28‑kg weight make it easy to transport between labs or field stations. The adapter offers secure mounting with a quick‑release screw, ensuring stable alignment during long experiments. Compatible with Olympus, Leica, Zeiss, and other major microscope systems, it allows researchers to extend optical capabilities without purchasing new objectives. The product is ideal for educational institutions, research laboratories, and industrial inspection setups.
